mentions.name: AI-powered Craigslist apartment search
mentions.description: This personal AI tool scoured Craigslist listings for the author's recent apartment search, evaluating must-have criteria in listing text and examining images of promising listings. It favored casting a wide net and fine-tuning requirements as results came in, with the goal of quality over speed.
mentions.problem: Wished-for sources like Zillow have no public API, so the core challenge is APIs and integrations.
mentions.audience: The author's own personal apartment search
mentions.source_excerpt: I did do this for a recent search. It scoured Craigslist listings, first evaluating must haves in text and looking at images for the promising listings. Crucially I wanted to first cast a wide net and fine tune my reqs as I learned what it turned up.
mentions.author: achllle
